evidence.title: UXmatters :: Insights and inspiration for the user experience community

name: UXmatters
summary: Web magazine of articles and columns on UX research, strategy, design and the business of user experience.
description: UXmatters is an online magazine founded in 2005 that publishes articles and regular columns by UX practitioners, grouped into topics such as business, code, community, design, experiences, process, research, reviews and strategy. Readers get editions published roughly every two weeks, a top-articles page, an author index and a glossary.

articles and columns in editions that appear about every two weeks
topics: business, code, community, design, experiences, process, research, reviews, strategy
